subject.title: Feishu: replied/quoted message mentions show as raw @_user_N placeholders

question: Should maintainers adopt the open cross-repo fork PR for this Feishu quoted-mention bug, ask for a narrow refreshed replacement, or close that candidate and sponsor a small in-repo fix?
rationale: The remaining implementation shape is narrow, but an open conflicting cross-repo PR still claims this issue and the issue is labeled to avoid a new automated fix PR.

options.title: Request a narrow refreshed fix
options.body: Ask the contributor or a maintainer to replace the 18-file conflicting branch with a focused `send.ts`/`send.test.ts` repair that normalizes fetched-message mentions.

options.title: Adopt the fork PR after narrowing
options.body: Keep the existing cross-repo PR as the candidate only if its author rebases, trims unrelated churn, and adds focused proof for quoted/thread mention normalization.

options.title: Sponsor a maintainer-owned fix
options.body: Close or detach the stale cross-repo candidate and have an area owner land the small parser-boundary fix directly.

recommendation.title: Request a narrow refreshed fix
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor or a maintainer to replace the 18-file conflicting branch with a focused `send.ts`/`send.test.ts` repair that normalizes fetched-message mentions.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu mention rendering work and member-authored repair history make this the strongest routing candidate among the likely owners found.
